_note: Sound-spelling mapping for each lesson: one row per word, one box per sound, and the grapheme that goes in each box. 95% Group's weekly timing guide gives this five minutes on Day 1 plus a whole OPTION day, and it is the routine their chip kits are built around. The teacher says the word and the child writes one grapheme per box, which is where a child learns that sh is one sound written with two letters. Boxes come from the grapheme reader in lib/syllable-split.mjs, with silent e reshaped into the split spelling a teacher writes; every row is then proved against the pronouncing dictionary, so the number of boxes is the number of sounds and not a guess from the spelling. Generated by scripts/build-sound-mapping.mjs; do not hand-edit.
